name: tex-selection-translator
description: Microsoft Edge extension for translating selected text on Overleaf, PDF documents, and ordinary web pages.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:edge && npm run test:e2e:built
scripts.test:e2e:built: playwright test tests/e2e/web-reading.spec.ts tests/e2e/web-selection.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-document.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-math-regression.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-translation-reliability.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-paragraph-flow.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-paper-metadata.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-equation-numbering.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-product-workflow.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-library-cost-excerpts.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-reading-workflow.spec.ts tests/e2e/term-excerpts.spec.ts tests/e2e/term-reuse.spec.ts tests/e2e/research-reading.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-region-ocr.spec.ts tests/e2e/translation-surfaces.spec.ts tests/e2e/browser-sidebar.spec.ts tests/e2e/settings-integration.spec.ts tests/e2e/release-upgrade.spec.ts tests/e2e/options-api-setup.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-wheel-zoom.spec.ts
scripts.test:marketing: npm run build:edge && playwright test tests/e2e/marketing-screenshots.spec.ts
scripts.check:release: npm run zip:edge && npm run check:release-artifact
scripts.test:product: playwright test tests/e2e/pdf-product-workflow.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-library-cost-excerpts.spec.ts tests/e2e/pdf-reading-workflow.spec.ts tests/e2e/term-excerpts.spec.ts tests/e2e/term-reuse.spec.ts tests/e2e/research-reading.spec.ts
scripts.test:design: npm run build:edge && npm run test:layout:built
